description: Design and implement static and interactive visualizations. Select appropriate visualization methods according to data type and intended analysis task. Create variations of visual representations. Critique designs. Assess visual representations according to design and perceptual principles.

• Complete all of:
    • SENG310 - Human Computer Interaction (1.5)

title: Information Visualization
